subject: Starnet onboarding: access matrix, hosts, and dry-run scheduling
messages:

To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@starnet.io>, Starnet Implementation <impl@starnet.io>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starnet - access matrix + proposed dry-run windows

Hi team,

Quick note to get Week 0 prep moving. Attached is the access matrix I collected from the Starnet intake form — please review the permissions and make sure it maps to our host roster.

Proposed dry-run windows (all PST):
- Mon May 3, 16:00 - 16:45 (preferred)
- Tue May 4, 09:00 - 09:45 (fallback)

Primary goals for dry-run: bridge/access checks, SSO test, and run through first 15 minutes of the orientation agenda.

Olga/Monica/Jordan: can you confirm staffing (host/presenter/backup) and whether you need additional test artifacts?

Elena/Rajiv: can you confirm who from Starnet will join the dry-run and whether any network/firewall folks need to be on the call?

Attachments: [starnet-access-matrix.xlsx]

Thanks,
Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Starnet - access matrix + proposed dry-run windows

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the matrix and annotated two gaps (SSO service account and jump-host IP allowlist). I attached a lightweight checklist for the dry-run with responsibilities.

Staffing from our side:
- Host / session lead: Monica Patel (main bridge)
- Technical owner (SSO/infra): Jordan Blake (will own failover steps)
- Customer success backup: Olga Petrov (point for questions)

Monica/Jordan I set tentative roles in the attached checklist. Please reply if you want different assignments.

Elena — can you confirm whether your network team will attend (name + email) so we can add them to the access matrix? If there are IP ranges to allow, please paste them into the shared Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-starnet-onboard

Suggested short agenda for dry-run (30–45 min):
1) 5m - Introductions and objectives
2) 10m - Bridge and SSO connectivity tests (Jordan)
3) 10m - Demo run of orientation start (Monica)
4) 10m - Triage/next steps and hit list (all)

Attachments: [dryrun-checklist.pdf], [starnet-access-matrix.xlsx]

Olga
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
